parts.name: M6 × 10 button-head bolt
parts.detail: Designer length. ISO 7380 envelope, 10.5 mm head and 3.3 mm head height.

parts.name: M6 heat-set insert
parts.detail: 8 mm outside diameter. The model uses the supported 4 mm length. The designer also supports 5 mm inserts. Confirm which length is installed before ordering replacements.

parts.name: M6 hex nut
parts.detail: 10 mm across flats and 5 mm high. Only the six rear shelf pockets use regular M6 nuts.

parts.name: M2.5 × 6 shelf standoff
parts.detail: Twelve 6 mm bodies below the Pis. Male-to-female connection shown with a 6 mm lower stud through the shelf and a nut. Body length and quantity follow the shelf designer. Stud length needs physical confirmation.

parts.name: M2.5 hex nut
parts.detail: Four nuts below each Pi shelf position. Nominal 5 mm across flats and 2 mm high.

parts.name: PoE HAT kit standoff
parts.detail: Four per HAT. The display body spans the 15.494 mm gap between the supplied CAD boards, with an illustrative 4 mm lower stud. Exact supplied length is unverified. Use the kit hardware. The lower stud replaces the standalone shelf design’s upper Pi screw.

parts.name: PoE HAT kit top screw
parts.detail: Four per HAT. A nominal M2.5 × 6 envelope is shown at the top board. Verify the supplied length if replacing the screws.

parts.name: ZimaBoard original mounting screw
parts.detail: Two diagonal screws reused through the printed bracket, as the mount designer specifies. The visible M3 × 8 envelope is illustrative. Exact thread and length are unverified. Do not order from this envelope.

configuration.railInsertPopulation: All 180 front and rear rail holes

notes: Quantities describe this modeled assembly, with all 180 rail holes populated with inserts.
The frame and extension joints add 40 inserts and 40 M6 bolts.
Threads use nominal envelopes. Decorative thread helices are omitted.
Only assembly hardware is counted. Factory internals remain part of the purchased equipment.
The Netgear mount’s original slot centers differ vertically from the rail by about 0.55 mm. M6 shaft clearance needs a physical fit check.
Kit fastener lengths and the shelf standoff stud length remain unverified. Use supplied hardware where listed.

includedHardware.name: PoE HAT fan screws
includedHardware.detail: Two factory fan screws per HAT. Already rendered within the device meshes, so no duplicate fastener is added.
